Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 29

“Those deluded by the qualities of nature become attached to their functions. The one who knows the whole should not unsettle those dull ones who know only in part.”

The caution of verse twenty-six returns, now with its reason attached. Partial knowledge is fragile, and Krishna asks that it not be knocked over by someone who can see further.
